scripts.build:daemon: TRIPLE=$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/^host: //p') && mkdir -p src-tauri/binaries && if [ -n "$TAURI_ENV_DEBUG" ]; then (cd src-tauri && cargo build -p hillstonux-daemon) && cp src-tauri/target/debug/hillstonux-daemon src-tauri/binaries/hillstonux-daemon-$TRIPLE; else (cd src-tauri && cargo build --release -p hillstonux-daemon) && cp src-tauri/target/release/hillstonux-daemon src-tauri/binaries/hillstonux-daemon-$TRIPLE; fi
